objective: Minimize cell area times activity-annotated total power among provenance-complete, signoff-clean and equivalence-proven candidates; report core area and worst setup/hold slack separately. Missing activity power excludes ranking, never substitute vectorless power.
selection: Retain at most two nondominated measured seeds over area, activity power, core area and setup slack within each arm; one is the lowest objective candidate, the other is the best remaining tradeoff. All arms start with the identical measured seeds. Proposals cite their chosen seed and change one axis.
visibility: Every model call is a new tool-disabled Codex session in an empty directory. full_history replays that arm's earlier prompts/responses and measured rows; fresh_evidence exposes measured rows without earlier model responses; seed_only exposes only the selected retained seeds. This is a context-policy ablation, not a continuous-session or causal test of the conditional trigger.
deduplication: Freeze model responses before tool execution. Execute each effective override/PDK/SCL/flow signature at most once in this experiment. A repeated configuration receives the retained exact measurement, labelled cache reuse. Each arm is charged one evaluation exposure per proposal, including cache reuse; actual tool executions and costs are reported separately. Independent model repetitions do not provide independent physical repeats.
gates: all reported setup and hold corners
all required electrical and antenna limits
stagnation_observation: Record whether the best objective improves by more than 0.5 percent over a two-round window. Empty/duplicate proposals are supporting signals. This observation does not alter the preregistered visibility assignments.
reporting: Per-policy proposal validity, empty responses, within-arm repeats, unique configurations, cross-arm overlap, input/output/reasoning tokens, wall time, verified success and normalized best-objective trajectory. Report each paired replicate and the range/median; three model repeats on one small design cannot establish general EDA superiority or physical noise significance. No known historical candidate is assigned new provenance.
